If background execution is available without occupying the main conversation, use design_recheck_reviews normally in the background without waiting for completion. If background execution is unavailable or would occupy the main conversation, ask whether the user wants to turn off automatic GRA while keeping manual checks, or run this review synchronously in the main conversation. Use executionMode="foreground" only after explicit confirmation of synchronous execution. Do not change the review policy or start synchronous execution without the user’s choice.
